task.title: TestStatusCarriesTheIgnoredRefsTheLastSyncObserved flakes on a slow runner
task.description:
Seen on macos-15 in CI for PR #192 (run 44923634516): 'ignored refs after origin no longer holds one = [refs/workbook/tasks/EVIL], want none'. Passed on rerun and on the other platforms.

The test in internal/syncloop/loop_test.go waits with waitForSyncs, which returns once the fake syncer has counted the second sync. The watcher stores that sync's status afterwards, so the test can read the status of the first sync. Any other test that reads status right after waitForSyncs has the same window.

Done when the test waits for the status the sync produced rather than for the sync call, the same race is closed in the sibling tests, and the test survives repeated runs under load.
